daily_load_assessment: Current CTL is 12.9 with an ATL of 6.6, putting TSB in positive fresh territory (+6.3). You have had 3 full rest days since your last 7.8km run on November 2. While your recovery markers indicate high readiness, your acute chronic load is critically low, meaning cardiovascular and muscular adaptations have stagnated.
acute_status_assessment_3_weeks: Over the last 21 days, you have logged only 2 running sessions totaling 1 hour of exercise and 71 training load. This acute window reflects severe detraining and a lack of baseline volume. Rebuilding consistency is mandatory before aggressively pushing high acute workloads.
sport_trend_assessment_6_months: Your 6-month macro trend shows a sharp decline from summer peaks (where you sustained high-volume cycling and long efforts) down to a CTL of 12.9. To reach your target CTL of 60 safely, you need a disciplined ramp rate of +1 to +2 CTL per week, heavily supported by your 70/30 pyramidal distribution.
coach_verdict: Execute Priority 1 today. Your chronic fitness has dropped significantly, and jumping straight into extreme high-intensity intervals after 3 days of complete inactivity risks injury. A steady Zone 2 endurance ride will jumpstart your CTL build safely.

priority_1.workout_details: 90 minutes steady Zone 2 cycling. Warm up 10 mins @ 120W, hold 155-165W for 70 mins at 90 RPM cadence, cool down 10 mins.
priority_1.reason: Highest priority to safely re-introduce aerobic volume and start ramping CTL from 12.9 without high structural fatigue.

priority_2.workout_details: 15 min WU in Z2, 3 x 8 min @ 230-240W with 4 min Z1 recovery, 15 min CD.
priority_2.reason: Since TSB is positive and fatigue is low, a controlled quality session targetting 20-min power is permissible if feeling sharp.

priority_3.workout_details: Barbell Squats 4x6 @ 80kg, Barbell Bench Press 4x8 @ 65kg, Barbell Deadlifts 3x5 @ 95kg, Sandbag Hug Carries 3x45sec, Bicep Curls 3x10.
priority_3.reason: Provides a non-cardiovascular stimulus to strengthen cycling torque and upper body aesthetics without taxing endurance running legs.
